text:
alice: Starting rollout plan for model catalog entry mosaic-v2-small: staged enable + variant priority ordering. Plan: 5% canary global, 25% region EU, then 100% after 2h if metrics good. Fallback order: mosaic-v2-small -> mosaic-v1-quant -> mosaic-legacy.
ben: Recommend pinning mosaic-v1-quant for enterprise tenants during canary; avoid auto-upgrade.
carol: +1. We should add per-tenant pin rule in catalog config.
alice: Agree. Adding pin for tenants: @deploy-bot can you attach rollout config?
deploy-bot: deploy job started: model-catalog/rollout:mosaic-v2-small canary (id: roll-1779504321). See https://ci.redwood/roll/roll-1779504321. Status: queued.
dave: Rollout KPIs: error rate <= 0.5%, 95p latency delta <= +50ms, hallucination score delta <= +2 on eval set. If any triggers, auto-rollback.
eve: Change window is 23:00-03:00 PDT. Ops: FYI, we'll email enterprise customers with pinned models note.
alice: Here's the catalog snippet I'll push:
```json
{"model": "mosaic-v2-small", "variants": ["mosaic-v2-small","mosaic-v1-quant","mosaic-legacy"], "fallback_priority": ["mosaic-v2-small","mosaic-v1-quant","mosaic-legacy"], "canary_percent": 5, "stages": [{"region": "eu", "percent": 25}], "pinning_policy": "per-tenant-allow"}
```
ben: Does the runtime support KV-cache compatibility between v1 and v2? We need fallback to reuse cache.
carol: It doesn't. We'll add explicit cache warmup on failover to reduce latency spike.
alice: Noted. Added an automatic warmup job in plan.
deploy-bot: roll-1779504321 moved to in-progress on host pool-east-1. Step: catalog-update -> health-checks.
dave: Monitoring hooks: teams/eng-runtime, eng-sre alert on error_rate>0.5% for >2min, and slow-req spike >200 req/min.
eve: If all green at T+2h, we promote to 50% and schedule full rollout at next change window.
ben: One more ask: include a rollback playbook link in the release note.
alice: Added: https://handbook.redwood/runbooks/model-rollbacks. Also tagging the canary with label canary-mosaic-v2.
carol: +1. Approving rollout. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: roll-1779504321 health-checks passed (latency 95p +12ms, errors 0.12%). Canary active at 5%.
alice: Thanks. Keeping a close eye. If we see alert, manual rollback authorized to @dave and @carol.
eve: I'll draft the release note and push to #announcements after 2h check.
alice: End of thread — follow-ups will be separate alerts.
